items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(sessions) FILTER (
      WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    ) AS this_week_sessions,
    SUM(sessions) FILTER (
      WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
        AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    ) AS last_week_sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date <= current_date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  COALESCE(last_week_sessions, 0) AS last_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(this_week_sessions, 0) AS this_week_sessions,
  COALESCE(this_week_sessions, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_sessions, 0) AS change_sessions,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(this_week_sessions, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_sessions, 0)) * 100.0
      / NULLIF(last_week_sessions, 0),
    1
  ) AS change_percent
FROM weekly
ORDER BY this_week_sessions DESC, traffic_source

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions)::numeric AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::integer AS iso_weekday,
       to_char(summary_date, 'FMDay') AS weekday_name,
       ROUND(AVG(sessions), 2) AS avg_daily_sessions,
       COUNT(*) AS days_with_data
FROM daily
GROUP BY iso_weekday, weekday_name
ORDER BY iso_weekday

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH period_events AS (
  SELECT session_id, timestamp, device_type, event_name
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 7
    AND timestamp < current_date
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL
), session_rollup AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         (array_agg(device_type ORDER BY timestamp))[1] AS device_type,
         bool_or(event_name = 'is_payment') AS had_payment
  FROM period_events
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown') AS device_type,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE had_payment) AS payment_sessions,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE had_payment) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS payment_conversion_rate_pct
FROM session_rollup
GROUP BY COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown')
ORDER BY device_type

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, COUNT(*)::numeric AS unique_visitors
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
), period_daily AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 THEN '최근 7일'
           ELSE '그 전 7일'
         END AS period,
         unique_visitors
  FROM daily
), averages AS (
  SELECT period, COUNT(*) AS data_days, AVG(unique_visitors) AS avg_daily_unique_visitors
  FROM period_daily
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT period, data_days, ROUND(avg_daily_unique_visitors, 2) AS avg_daily_unique_visitors,
       ROUND(MAX(avg_daily_unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE period = '최근 7일') OVER () -
             MAX(avg_daily_unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE period = '그 전 7일') OVER (), 2) AS difference,
       ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(avg_daily_unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE period = '최근 7일') OVER () /
             NULLIF(MAX(avg_daily_unique_visitors) FILTER (WHERE period = '그 전 7일') OVER (), 0) - 1), 2) AS change_pct
FROM averages
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '최근 7일' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', current_date)::date AS this_week_start), counts AS (SELECT event_name, SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= b.this_week_start - 7 AND summary_date < b.this_week_start)::bigint AS last_week_count, SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= b.this_week_start)::bigint AS this_week_count FROM agg_event_daily CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE summary_date >= b.this_week_start - 7 AND summary_date <= current_date GROUP BY event_name) SELECT event_name, COALESCE(last_week_count, 0) AS last_week_count, COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) AS this_week_count, COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_count, 0) AS change_count, ROUND((COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_count, 0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(last_week_count, 0), 1) AS change_pct FROM counts ORDER BY this_week_count DESC, event_name

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7) AS week_start,
         date_trunc('week', current_date)::date AS week_end
), first_seen AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(summary_date) AS first_date
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY client_id
), week_visitors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
  FROM agg_daily_users d CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE d.summary_date >= b.week_start AND d.summary_date < b.week_end
    AND d.client_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b.week_start, b.week_end - 1 AS week_last_day,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.first_date >= b.week_start AND f.first_date < b.week_end) AS new_visitors,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.first_date < b.week_start) AS returning_visitors,
       COUNT(*) AS total_visitors
FROM week_visitors w
CROSS JOIN bounds b
LEFT JOIN first_seen f ON f.client_id = w.client_id
GROUP BY b.week_start, b.week_end

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 기기 유형별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
       AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date THEN '지난주'
      WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date THEN '이번 주'
    END AS period,
    device_type,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date <= current_date
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT device_type,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '지난주'), 0) AS last_week_sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '이번 주'), 0) AS this_week_sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '이번 주'), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '지난주'), 0) AS change_sessions,
       ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '이번 주'), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '지난주'), 0)) * 100.0
         / NULLIF(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE period = '지난주'), 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM weekly
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘

items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions)::numeric AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
), classified AS (
  SELECT summary_date, sessions,
         CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date) IN (6, 7) THEN '주말' ELSE '평일' END AS day_type

items.question: 15일 전과 14일 전의 기기 유형별 결제 완료 건수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH filtered_events AS (
  SELECT timestamp::date AS event_date, COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown') AS device_type
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= (current_date - 15)::timestamp
    AND timestamp < (current_date - 13)::timestamp
    AND event_name = 'is_payment'
), device_types AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY['desktop', 'mobile', 'tablet']) AS device_type
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT device_type FROM filtered_events
), counts AS (
  SELECT device_type,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_date = current_date - 15) AS payments_15_days_ago,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_date = current_date - 14) AS payments_14_days_ago
  FROM filtered_events
  GROUP BY device_type
)
SELECT d.device_type,
       COALESCE(c.payments_15_days_ago, 0) AS payments_15_days_ago,
       COALESCE(c.payments_14_days_ago, 0) AS payments_14_days_ago,
       COALESCE(c.payments_14_days_ago, 0) - COALESCE(c.payments_15_days_ago, 0) AS change
FROM device_types d
LEFT JOIN counts c USING (device_type)
ORDER BY d.device_type

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date,
         CASE
           WHEN summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date THEN '이번 달'
           WHEN summary_date >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
            AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date THEN '지난달'
         END AS period,
         sum(page_views) AS page_views
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
    AND summary_date <= current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date, period
)
SELECT period,
       count(*) AS data_days,
       sum(page_views) AS total_page_views,
       round(avg(page_views)::numeric, 2) AS avg_daily_page_views
FROM daily
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '지난달' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 전환 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    traffic_source,
    SUM(conversions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7 AND summary_date < current_date) AS recent_7d_conversions,
    SUM(conversions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date - 7) AS prior_7d_conversions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  COALESCE(recent_7d_conversions, 0) AS recent_7d_conversions,
  COALESCE(prior_7d_conversions, 0) AS prior_7d_conversions,
  COALESCE(recent_7d_conversions, 0) - COALESCE(prior_7d_conversions, 0) AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(recent_7d_conversions, 0) - COALESCE(prior_7d_conversions, 0)) / NULLIF(prior_7d_conversions, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY recent_7d_conversions DESC NULLS LAST, traffic_source

items.question: 최근 14일 일별 모바일과 데스크톱 세션 수를 날짜별 한 행에 나란히 보여줘
items.sql: SELECT d.summary_date, COALESCE(SUM(h.sessions) FILTER (WHERE h.device_type = 'mobile'), 0) AS mobile_sessions, COALESCE(SUM(h.sessions) FILTER (WHERE h.device_type = 'desktop'), 0) AS desktop_sessions FROM generate_series((current_date - 14)::timestamp, (current_date - 1)::timestamp, interval '1 day') AS d(summary_date) LEFT JOIN agg_user_session_hourly h ON h.summary_date = d.summary_date AND h.device_type IN ('mobile', 'desktop') GROUP BY d.summary_date ORDER BY d.summary_date

items.question: 지난주 세션 200개 이상인 유입 소스(traffic_source) 중 결제한 세션 비율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH source_sessions AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, SUM(sessions)::bigint AS sessions
  FROM agg_traffic_hourly
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY traffic_source
), paid_sessions AS (
  SELECT traffic_source, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)::bigint AS paying_sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND timestamp < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    AND event_name = 'is_payment'
  GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT s.traffic_source, s.sessions, COALESCE(p.paying_sessions, 0) AS paying_sessions,
       ROUND(COALESCE(p.paying_sessions, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.sessions, 0), 2) AS paying_session_rate_pct
FROM source_sessions s
LEFT JOIN paid_sessions p USING (traffic_source)
WHERE s.sessions >= 200
ORDER BY paying_session_rate_pct DESC, s.traffic_source
LIMIT 3
